scope: One separately authorised actual SHV diagnostic launch; changing raw observations are separate from operating-state qualification, product integration and audio testing.

decision.reason: No phase ADVANCE was recorded. The operator later confirmed enabling and stopping capture without advancing labels. The changing signal is established, but the approved phase chronology and full operating-state contract remain unestablished.

actualExecution.gameVersionBasis: Protected executable hash matches the preserved verified build baseline

timing.interpretation: Relative monotonic observation timings; target window includes dispatch/copy bookkeeping and is not a native handler or audio performance benchmark
timing.basis: Relative monotonic timings. Zero is activeStartQpc; absolute QPC values remain private.

laterClarification.paraphrase: The operator reported enabling capture and stopping it without advancing phase labels.

longestIdenticalBitsRun.interpretation: A stable repeated value is not by itself a stale-read failure

keyboardIntent.scope: SDK notification model only. No W-down sample is present; this does not identify actual throttle, controller use or physical engine actuation.

humanObservation.statement: idle, stationary revving, significant acceleration, acceleration redlining doing a wheelie, deceleration and idle again

exploratoryContextReview.label: Exploratory only: independent speed/engine context selection ignores requested phase labels and cannot satisfy or relabel the approved primary experiment
exploratoryContextReview.baselineSelection: Engine-running both contexts, speed both <=0.10m/s, measured ratio within 0.03 of the prior 0.20 idle candidate; this is a signal-region description, not independent physical-idle or throttle proof
exploratoryContextReview.activitySelection: All non-overlapping 3-second bins anchored at active start with at least 2 s of actual sample span; selected only by independent speed quarter-median change >=2 m/s; ratio quarter-median direction assessed afterwards
exploratoryContextReview.ratioVersusSpeedCaution: The fixed speed-selected windows include opposite and small ratio trends as well as matching trends. Gear/load/actuation changes could affect these relations, but their causes are unobserved and must not be invented.
exploratoryContextReview.status: Exploratory descriptive analysis only; no replacement or relabelling of primary requested-phase criteria

trajectory.basis: All one-second bins anchored at active start using target-before timestamps. No achieved phase is assigned. Ratio decodes rawBits; speed independently decodes preContext.speedBits. No smoothing, interpolation or speed-to-ratio conversion.

cleanup.qualification: Historical close/dialog/confirmation claims are receipt-based; current process absence and byte preservation were independently verified.

limits: The signal genuinely varies, but response across independently marked operating states is not yet qualified.
All requested labels remained OFF while both engine queries were1; OFF is not engine-off evidence.
The operator confirmed no phase-advance attempt; no keyboard defect is established.
The later human report is qualitative and untimed; it does not restore missing primary phase chronology.
Gear, throttle, physical RPM and redline are unavailable; the ratio/speed relation is not assumed monotonic.
Exploratory regions and bins do not assign achieved phases or relax frozen criteria.
An identical raw-value run is not by itself stale-read proof; handler internals and universal build/vehicle semantics remain unestablished.
No further capture, deployment, launch, integration or audio test is authorised by this record.
privacy: No process identifiers, native handles, absolute local paths, absolute QPC timestamps, raw pointers, capture-directory identifiers or raw log text are included. Raw captures and logs remain private.
